## Overview

Bayer is named as a funder of the ROCKET AF trial, which was funded by Johnson & Johnson and Bayer ([src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_8ff4bad2e9d926335b4de77ad1e41630.md)).
